summary:
Everyone is selling the same thing. Same products, same prices, same Instagram posts. So how do you actually get people to choose you?

In Part 2 of the Saturated Market Series, Seamas and Sharon break down what it really takes to build a brand that stands out in Nigeria — not just a logo or a colour palette, but the full experience that makes customers come back and tell their friends.
title: How To Build a Brand That Stands Out in Nigeria | Saturated Market Series Pt 2
